title: A vehicle looking to stop its vehicle has found a suitable space
situation: A vehicle looking to stop its vehicle has found a suitable space
entities: 1. Vehicle 1 (One which is trying to stop) 2. Vehicle 2 (One which is just behind the stopping vehicle) 3. Rest of the vehicles in the road stretch.
description: Vehicles are moving on road, one of which is moving with intention to stop by roadside
dialogue_prompts: 1. Is there a conflict? Yes, vehicle 1 is trying to stop while vehicle 2 is in its own motion. 2. Is Reason Good? No, vehicle 1 is trying to stop by roadside which breaks traffic flow 3. Is settlement good? Case - Yes Vehicle 2 agrees to let the other vehicle to slow down and eventually stop and even change lane. Case - No Vehicle 2 disregards the requests and continues its own motion.
source_proposed_solutions: 1. Vehicle 1 informs Vehicle 2, it is willing to change lane if required, gradually slowing speed and stop by roadside. 2. Vehicle 2 is in high speed thus warning Vehicle to either not slow down or come into its lane. 3. Otherwise Vehicle 2 informs other vehicles behind itself in a cascading fashion to slow down and itself does the same. 4. Vehicle 1, if can’t spot another location, tries to communicate with Vehicle 2 that Vehicle 1 will be attempting a stopping maneuver anyways.
peas: 1. PerformanceMeasure-Ifvehicle1wantstostopbyroadside,vehicle2mustbeinformedattheearliest time, and acknowledgement must be communicated to maintain road safety 2. Environment - A vehicle on a congested road is trying to stop while been followed by other vehicles. 3. Actuator - Transmitter in vehicles, Lane change and deceleration mechanism in vehicles 4. Sensor - Receiver in vehicles and traffic signals, proximity sensor
cascading_problems: 1. Vehicle wants a parking spot (intentional stoppage) but there is no parking spot available in the road stretch ahead (Discussed). 2. Vehicle 2 or some other wants to stop at that spot itself (Discussed). 3. Vehicles behind vehicle 2 are warning not to attempt a stopping maneuver (this can be done with IoVTS to prioritize) (Resolution in implementation). 4. Vehicle 1 has stopped but dynamic traffic signal recording traffic flow does not know the situation (Discussed).
